name: Naruto · Powers
description: Name the jutsu, eyes and modes of Naruto, from the Rasengan and Chidori to Susanoo and the Rinnegan.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Naruto's spinning sphere of chakra, which he learned from Jiraiya.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Lightning chakra in the hand, created by Kakashi and used by Sasuke.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Naruto's trademark: splits his chakra into solid copies of himself.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Uchiha eye that copies jutsu and reads movements; Kakashi has one too.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Hyuga eye with near-360° vision that sees chakra flow and through walls.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Ultimate eye that bends chakra and gravity; Nagato and Sasuke wielded it.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Natural-energy mode that Naruto learned from Jiraiya and the toads.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Giant chakra warrior that surrounds its user; Sasuke, Itachi and Madara wielded it.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Black flames that burn until the target is consumed; a Mangekyō power.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Rock Lee's taijutsu: opening the gates gives huge power at a terrible cost.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Reanimates the dead as controllable bodies; Orochimaru and Kabuto used it.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: A tailed beast's ball of compressed chakra, fired at enemies by Kurama.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Advanced Sharingan that unlocks powers like Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Advanced Mangekyō form, awakened only after great trauma; Sasuke's eyes.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: A Rasengan infused with wind chakra, Naruto's powerful spinning blade.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Dimension-warping ability that pulls targets or attacks into another space; Obito's.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Pain's gravity push that blasts everything away from the user.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Planetary Devastation: pulls the land into a floating black orb.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Lightning Release technique that calls a thunder strike from the sky; created by Sasuke.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Calls summons such as toads, snakes and slugs through a blood contract.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Teleports the user to marked kunai; the Fourth Hokage Minato's signature.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Mangekyō genjutsu that traps the victim's mind in a 72-hour illusion.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Mokuton, Hashirama's bloodline: grows trees, walls and cages; Yamato uses it.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Shikamaru's jutsu that links his shadow to a foe and controls their body.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Fire Release: a huge fireball, a classic Uchiha technique like Itachi's.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Hyuga palm strikes that close chakra points; Neji uses it against Naruto.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Naruto's Six Paths power, drawn from the Sage of the Six Paths.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Kurama's chakra cloak: fox features, a fiery tail and a big power boost.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Roshi's bloodline: turns chakra into molten lava that burns everything.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Kimimaro's bone technique: spikes and blades grow from his own skeleton.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Uzumaki chakra chains, tough enough that even the Nine-Tails struggles to break them.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Ōnoki's Jinton that turns whatever it touches into fine dust.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Kakashi's chakra blade of lightning that pierces through targets.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: A ninja speed move that jumps the user in an instant, with a puff of smoke.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Kawarimi: swap places with a nearby log to dodge an attack.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Gaara's sand technique that encases an enemy in a sand coffin.

cards.label: technique
cards.hook: Yamanaka clan jutsu that moves the user's mind into another person's body.
